title: 60-Minute Statue of Liberty Cruise by Day or New York by Night Skyline Cruise - Up to 56% Off!
description:
Cruise Deal Options - Choose Your Experience:
60-Minute Statue of Liberty Sightseeing Cruise
for One, Two, Three, Four or Five.
Relax and enjoy your narrated 60-minute cruise to view the Statue of Liberty. Our yacht will take you within 100 feet of Lady Liberty. Enjoy indoor and outdoor seating as we travel along the East River. Your tour includes views of New York's famous skyline, including The Freedom Tower, Brooklyn Bridge, Manhattan Bridge, Governor's Island, Battery Park, Ellis Island and more.
Must be purchased in advance of arrival at the desired sailing time. Cannot be purchased at the Pier at the sailing time.
Sailing Times: 11am, 12:30pm, 2:30pm, 4:30pm, and 6:30pm
Available: Seven days a week in 2026
60-Minute "New York By Night" Cruise
for One, Two, Three, Four or Five.
Sunset Sailing Special
Experience the majesty of the Statue of Liberty at night with a 60-minute boat tour. Marvel at iconic landmarks such as the Freedom Tower, Brooklyn Bridge, and Ellis Island as you cruise along the East River and more. We sail within 100 feet of the Statue of Liberty and rotate the boat for perfect photo opportunities.
Sailing Time: 4:30PM and 6:30PM
Available: Seven days a week in 2026

Deal Details
Location:
299 South St, New York, NY 10002 [Pier 36] Dock #7 |
Our employees wear black uniforms.
Arrival:
Please arrive at least 15 minutes before your desired sailing time, as tours leave promptly.
Booking:
No booking required. Current sailing schedule available on our website.
Kids:
Free admission for children under 3.
Why This Cruise Deal Is Worth It
Experience breathtaking NYC sights on our USCG-certified yacht accommodating up to 300 passengers. Indoor and outdoor seating, spacious decks, and panoramic windows provide unmatched skyline views.
With over 25 years of experience, NYC Skyline Tours & Cruises ensures a memorable journey with amenities including professional photography, souvenirs, a fully stocked bar, and delicious snacks.

faqs.question: What group sizes can book the N.Y.C Skyline Tours & Cruises Statue of Liberty or NYC by Night & Skyline Lights Cruise?
faqs.answer: N.Y.C Skyline Tours & Cruises offers this 60-minute cruise for individuals or groups of up to five people, with dedicated options available for one, two, three, four, or five participants.

faqs.question: How long does the Statue of Liberty or NYC by Night & Skyline Lights Cruise last?
faqs.answer: Each cruise with N.Y.C Skyline Tours & Cruises lasts 60 minutes.

faqs.question: What are the two cruise experiences available through this deal?
faqs.answer: The deal offers a choice between a Statue of Liberty cruise and an NYC by Night & Skyline Lights Cruise, both operated by N.Y.C Skyline Tours & Cruises and lasting 60 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the Statue of Liberty or NYC by Night & Skyline Lights Cruise depart from in New York, NY?
faqs.answer: The cruise departs from N.Y.C Skyline Tours & Cruises at 299 South Street, New York, NY 10002.
